t: DEWALT DCB118-GB 18/54V Li-Ion XR multi-voltage fast charger efficiently powers all DEWALT XR 18V and XR FlexVolt slide pack batteries. Advanced charging technology automatically adjusts output current to suit the battery type and condition, ensuring optimal charging for various DEWALT power tools on site or in the workshop. A diagnostic LED indicator clearly communicates the battery's charge status, while the charger's compact design allows for easy storage and portability. Built for durability, the fast charger can be wall-mounted for a secure and tidy workspace. Operates at 240V, and provides an 8A charge, making it an essential accessory for trade professionals requiring reliable battery power.
